name: Lemat Ethiopian Restaurant & Cafe
hours: Opens 5pm Mon (per Yelp); full weekly hours not confirmed
description: Lemat is a warm, family-run Ethiopian restaurant on Adeline Street. Owner Gezu Mengistu runs it with his wife, Ejigayehu, while her sister Tigist Gelan leads the kitchen. It's known for tender, buttery kitfo, tangy injera made entirely from teff, and a generous vegetarian combination platter, with gluten-free and vegan-friendly options throughout. Finish with a traditional Ethiopian coffee ceremony.

name: Comal
hours: Opens 5pm daily (per Yelp); closing time not confirmed
description: Comal has been a downtown Berkeley favorite since 2012, when owner John Paluska opened it on Shattuck Avenue. The lively restaurant draws on the flavors of Oaxaca and other regions of Mexico, with shareable plates, wood-grilled meats and seafood, and handmade tortillas. A big bar pours margaritas and a deep list of mezcal and tequila, and the back patio is one of the nicer outdoor spots downtown. It holds a Michelin Bib Gourmand.

name: Iyasare
hours: Lunch 11:30am-2:30pm, dinner 5-8:30pm (per Yelp; verify days)
description: Iyasare is chef Shotaro Kamio's modern Japanese restaurant on Fourth Street. Kamio, formerly the chef at the beloved Yoshi's, opened it in late 2013 in the old O Chamé space at Fourth and Hearst. His cooking is refined yet approachable, drawing on the country cooking of northern Japan's Tohoku region alongside seasonal California ingredients. It serves lunch and dinner and has a pleasant patio, and it holds a Michelin Bib Gourmand.

name: Battambang
hours: Mon-Sat 11am-8pm; closed Sun (per official site)
description: Cozy Khmer restaurant popular for sour soup and Battambong noodles.

name: Tacubaya
hours: Mon-Thu 11am-8pm; Fri 11am-9pm; Sat 10am-9pm; Sun 10am-8pm (per website)
description: Tacubaya is a counter-service taqueria in the Fourth Street shopping district from Dona Savitsky, who created it as a casual sibling to her Temescal restaurant Doña Tomás. It has long been a go-to for handmade-tortilla tacos, chilaquiles and Mexican breakfast, with brunch served every day. Weekday happy hour and a relaxed dining room make it an easy stop while shopping on Fourth Street. It's recommended in the Michelin Guide.

name: Cha-Ya Vegetarian Japanese
hours: Lunch 12-3pm; dinner 5-8pm (per website)
description: Cha-Ya is a small, entirely vegan Japanese restaurant on Shattuck Avenue in North Berkeley. The menu covers plant-based takes on Japanese favorites, including sushi rolls, tempura, noodle soups and rice bowls, all without animal products. It's a longtime favorite with vegans and non-vegans alike, and the cozy room fills up quickly at dinner. Note that it's cash or Venmo only.

name: The Butcher's Son
description: The Butcher's Son bills itself as California's original vegan butcher. Siblings Christina and Peter opened it in February 2016 after growing up working in their father's American diner, and they set out to recreate that nostalgic comfort food without animal products. Everything is plant-based, including faux meats and cheeses developed in-house, which star in hearty sandwiches like a chopped cheese, a Reuben and chicken parm. There's also a bakery case, some gluten-free options and a popular weekend brunch.

name: Bar Panisse
hours: Daily 5-10pm (per website)
description: Bar Panisse is the newer sibling of Chez Panisse, opened in December 2025 next door on Shattuck Avenue. Led by chef Amelia Telc, it carries the mothership's farm-to-table approach into a more casual bar setting, with small plates that change with the seasons, such as sage and anchovy fritters in winter or fried soft-shell crab with celery root remoulade in spring. The cocktails are polished takes on classics, including a gimlet with Meyer lemon cordial and a Sazerac.

name: Sichuan Style Restaurant
hours: Daily 11am-9:15pm (per website)
description: Sichuan Style is a busy, well-loved spot on upper Solano Avenue for the bold, numbing heat of Sichuan cooking. Locals regularly name it among the best places to eat on Solano. The menu covers the classics, from mapo tofu and dry-fried green beans to spicy fish dishes and dan dan noodles, and it's open daily for lunch and dinner, with takeout available.

name: Noor Indian Fusion Kitchen
hours: Lunch 11am-2:30pm; dinner 4-9:30pm (per website, 'today' listing)
description: Noor Indian Fusion Kitchen serves Indian cooking with a modern, fusion twist on University Avenue. It is one of the most highly rated Indian restaurants in the area on Yelp and OpenTable, and it serves both lunch and dinner. It also caters events of all sizes.

name: Zaytoon Mediterranean Restaurant & Bar
hours: Lunch and dinner Tue-Sun; brunch Sat-Sun 11am-2:30pm; closed Mon
description: Zaytoon has been serving Middle Eastern and Mediterranean cooking on Albany's Solano Avenue since June 2016, blending traditional recipes with a fresh, contemporary spin. The menu runs from mezze and ribeye kebabs to entrées like braised short ribs, pan-seared branzino, roasted lamb shank and Moroccan roasted chicken. Weekend brunch brings Turkish breakfast, Greek omelets and kataifi pancakes. There's a full bar with weekday happy hour, and it's one of the top-rated restaurants in Albany.

name: Bowl'd Korean Rice Bar
hours: Daily from 11am; closing 9-11pm (Yelp and Instagram differ)
description: Bowl'd Korean Rice Bar is a Solano Avenue favorite for hearty Korean comfort food. The specialty is dolsot bibimbap, served sizzling in hot stone bowls so the rice crisps at the bottom, alongside Korean barbecue meats, stews and banchan. It's casual and family-friendly, open late for Solano, and consistently among Albany's highest-ranked restaurants.

name: 5 Tacos and Beers
hours: Mon, Wed, Thu, Sun 11am-8pm; Fri-Sat 11am-9pm (per website)
description: 5 Tacos and Beers is a family-owned taqueria from Lito Saldaña, whose family name also shows up on the house ale. It's known for organic ingredients and handmade corn tortillas, which make the menu naturally gluten-friendly, and for pairing tacos with local craft beer. Crispy tacos and traditional plates fill out the menu, and big party packs make it easy to feed a group. There's also a happy hour.

name: Brotzeit Lokal
hours: Mon-Thu 11am-9pm; Fri 11am-9:30pm; Sat 10:30am-9:30pm; Sun 10:30am-9pm (per official site)
description: Waterfront German beer garden with pretzels, schnitzel, and pig knuckle.

name: Cugini Ristorante
hours: About 11:30am-9pm daily (per Yelp; verify)
description: Cugini Ristorante has been serving Italian cooking on Solano Avenue since 1996. The kitchen is known for handcrafted pizzas from its wood-fired oven, along with pastas and Italian classics. There's a bar, and the restaurant takes reservations and caters events.

name: Everest Kitchen
hours: About 11:30am-9pm; closed Tue (per website/Yelp)
description: Everest Kitchen is a highly rated Himalayan restaurant on Albany's Solano Avenue, earning some of the strongest reviews on the street. The menu features Nepali favorites like momo dumplings alongside curries and tandoor dishes. It serves lunch and dinner, takes reservations, and offers online ordering for takeout.

name: Aangan
hours: Daily 11:30am-2:30pm & 4:30-9:30pm (per Tripadvisor; Yelp shows 11:30am-10pm)
description: Aangan is a popular Indian restaurant on San Pablo Avenue in Albany and a frequent recommendation among locals. The menu covers North Indian favorites, including curries, tandoori dishes and fresh-baked naan, with plenty of vegetarian options. It's open for lunch and dinner, with takeout available.

name: Pâtisserie Rotha
hours: Thu-Fri 7:30-11am; Sat-Sun 8-11am (per Instagram)
description: Pâtisserie Rotha is a small artisan French pastry shop on San Pablo Avenue that has drawn lines down the block since it opened in 2018, and it still sells out quickly. The case is filled with classic French pastries, brioche and crémeux, but the star is the Portuguese pastel de nata. It's open only a few mornings a week, so arrive early.

name: Daytrip
hours: Closes 8pm (per SF Standard, June 2025); full schedule not verified
description: Shared-plates New American spot known for its celery salad.

name: Degrees Plato Tap Room
description: Craft-beer taproom and bottle shop with tacos and a communal beer garden.

name: Mom's Pho & Banh Mi (Mom's Bun Mi)
C'era Una Volta Kitchen & Catering
description: C'era Una Volta ('once upon a time') was founded by Italians with roots in Palermo and Livorno and for years was a sit-down Alameda favorite. Chef Rutilio 'Rudy' Fanetti-Duran is one of only a handful of Bay Area chefs recognized by L'Associazione Cuochi Fiorentini, and the restaurant earned recognition from the Accademia Italiana della Cucina. Today it runs mostly as a kitchen and catering operation, offering weekly three-entrée meal packages, chef's specials for two or four, and party trays. Dishes range from truffle gnocchi and artichoke ravioli to a Tuscan mixed grill, with vegan options. It offers pickup, local delivery and catering (48 hours' notice).
